gettingHere.title: On foot
gettingHere.body: We're in the heart of Worthing town centre, a short stroll from the seafront and the main shopping streets.

gettingHere.title: By car
gettingHere.body: Several town-centre car parks are within a few minutes' walk of the centre, including the High Street multi-storey.

gettingHere.title: By bus
gettingHere.body: Frequent local services stop in the town centre, moments from our entrances.

gettingHere.title: By train
gettingHere.body: Worthing station is around a ten-minute walk away, with regular services along the coast and to London.

floorplan.body: One level, easy to navigate — here's the lie of the land before you arrive.

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: We're open Monday to Saturday 8:00am – 6:00pm, Sundays 9:30am – 4:00pm, and Bank Holiday Mondays 10:00am – 4:00pm. We're closed on Christmas Day, Boxing Day, New Year's Day and Easter Sunday. Individual stores may keep slightly different hours.

faqs.question: Where can I park?
faqs.answer: The centre doesn't have its own car park, but several town-centre car parks are a few minutes' walk away, including the High Street multi-storey.

faqs.question: Is the centre accessible?
faqs.answer: The shopping mall is indoor and on one level. If you have a specific access question, call us on 01903 207327 and we'll be happy to help.

faqs.question: Are dogs welcome?
faqs.answer: Assistance dogs are always welcome throughout the centre. Individual stores set their own policies for other dogs — when in doubt, just ask.

faqs.question: How do I enquire about renting a unit?
faqs.answer: Retail lettings are handled by Flude Property Consultants on 01273 727070 — see the lettings section below.

letting.heading: Retail space at the Guildbourne
letting.body: Join a community of independents and established names in the centre of Worthing. Unit enquiries are handled by our letting agents.
